content.study: Key managerial personnel. sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: Section 203 requires prescribed classes to appoint a managing director or CEO or manager and, in their absence, a whole-time director, a company secretary, and a CFO.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Key managerial personnel is defined in s. 2(51). A whole-time key managerial person shall not hold office in more than one company except as a director, with the subsidiary exception stated in the section. Appointment is by board resolution containing terms, filed with the Registrar. Vacancy is filled within six months.

sections.body: Prescribed class; Offices in s. 203; Single whole-time office; Six-month vacancy fill
